refund.text: // Exchanges & Returns// We offer exchange in sizes for all non-discounted items on our website. If the ordered piece doesn't fit you, please ship us the piece back with a small note of your size requirements, and send us an email at hello@kharakapas.com. If the style doesn't suit you, we can offer you a one-time use store credit voucher valid for 3 months provided the piece is unworn and intact with all the tags and labels. Please note that shipping costs are non-refundable and will not account for the amount of the store credit voucher. For products ordered from our 'Sample Sale' section. please note that the product is one of a kind and shall not be customized, exchanged or returned at any stage. Therefore, we request you to go through the measurements chart carefully. Exchanges and returns will not be accepted for any customized order. A product is eligible for exchange/return only if it is a standard product. We do not accept exchange & returns for any order shipped internationally unless the fault is at our end meaning that the product is defective or a wrong item/size was shipped. We will not entertain exchanges any later than a month. If you wish to return/exchange a piece, please send us a mail within 2 weeks of receiving your order. Please read item descriptions carefully and note sizes of products. Please also know monitors are calibrated differently and colours, while may be close, may not be 100% accurate. In the event of an exchange, the buyer is responsible for return shipping fees. Please note by purchasing from KharaKapas™ you as the buyer agree to our shopping terms, conditions and policies. You will be responsible for paying for your own shipping costs for returning your item. Shipping costs are non-refundable. If you are shipping an item over Rs 2500, you should consider using a trackable shipping service or purchasing shipping insurance. We don’t guarantee that we will receive your returned item. // Sale items // Only regular priced (non-discounted) items of standard sizes may be returned/exchanged. U nfortunately, all sale items are available at their best & final price and cannot be returned. // Gifts // If the item was marked as a gift when purchased and shipped directly to you, you’ll receive a gift credit for the value of your return. Once the returned item is received, a gift certificate will be mailed to you. If the item wasn’t marked as a gift when purchased, or the gift giver had the order shipped to themselves to give to you later, we will send a refund to the gift giver and he will find out about your return. Refund Policy In case of damaged/defective products, refunds will be initiated through the same mode as the payment within 10 working days. <section

shipping.text: Shipping Information //Delivery Time// On placing your order, you will receive an email containing a summary of the order and also the estimated delivery time to your location. From the date of placing order, we would normally take 10-14 working days to deliver your order. In few locations, the delivery may take longer, depending on the accessibility of your location by our logistics partners. In such cases, we will proactively reach out to you. Please check your emails and SMS regularly for such updates. In case you need a garment by a particular date, please reach out to our team and inform us in advance. // International Shipping // International: We ship worldwide. Please choose your shipping zone while placing your order. Your purchase will be shipped through a reliable courier partner. Please allow up to 3 weeks for your package to arrive. Some areas may take longer depending on customs. Please note that we do not accept exchange & returns for any order shipped internationally unless the fault is at our end meaning that the product is defective or a wrong item/size was shipped. For all international orders, shipping, duties, and taxes are included in the price you pay. You will not be charged any additional shipping or customs fees when your order is delivered. Cancellation Policy Cancellation will only be accepted if your order hasn't been shipped. <section

If an incorrect size or product has been delivered to you i.e. the product does not match the item in the order confirmation email. If the product you have received has a genuine quality/manufacturing defect. If you feel the product is damaged or has a manufacturing defect, please do photograph this as soon as you have opened the packaging. If your purchase meets our refund criteria stated above, please contact us within 24 hours of delivery with the following information: Order number, Contact Name, Mobile number, specific reason for return, Also, in case of a defective or incorrect product, please send us an image of the product within 24 hours of receiving the product. We will not be able to process any refund if you fail to send image of defective or wrong product within 24 hours. ou may contact us via email at contact@theburntsoul.com or call our customer care at +91-7827759640,from Monday to Saturday, between 10.30 am to 5.30 pm (IST). We will look into the issue and respond to you within 48 working hours. We will inspect and if all found fair , we will immediately process the return pick up. Once return received , we will process the refund back . The whole process can take up to 10-20 days. International Orders are not eligible for returns or refunds. NOTE :- Any case other than above , we can only exchange or provide credit note. What if I need a different size in the same clothing style I have purchased? Please refer to the size chart before you make a purchase, and in case you are confused about your size, do write to us at contact@theburntsoul.com or chat online with us or call or WhatsApp us at +91-7827759640,. If you would like a different size in the same style of clothing that you have purchased, you will need to go through the following steps: Contact us to schedule a reverse pick-up. Once the unused product is received at our end, we will issue you a credit note (after deducting the applicable shipping charges) (you can email or call us to know the exact charges). You can then use the credit note to place a new order and choose the correct size. Can I exchange a customized Product? No, customized/made to measure products are not eligible for exchange/return. Please make sure you provide the correct measurements while getting the product(s) customized as per your requirements. In case you need any assistance or help, do write to us at contact@theburntsoul.com or chat online with us or call or WhatsApp us at +91-7827759640. Can I exchange the product if I don ’ t like it? You can still exchange the product, but make sure you follow the details below: Contact us to schedule a reverse pick-up. Please email us with your order number, contact name, and number and specify the reason for the return. Please make sure you have the return slip with you, if not, please email us for the same. You will need to fill the details on return slip and stick on the package before we arrange a reverse pick-up Once the item dispatched from your end reaches our warehouse, we will inspect the condition of the product. If the product is found unused, we will issue a credit note after deducting applicable shipping charges and COD charges. You can email us at contact@theburntsoul.com or call or WhatsApp us on +91-7827759640, to know the exact amount of credit note you are eligible for. If I have purchased a product from Sale/discounted items, can I still exchange the size or complete product? Please note that size exchanges or product exchanges will not be possible if the product is purchased from discounted/sale items. Can I exchange or return the used piece? Once the item dispatched from your end reaches our warehouse, we will inspect the condition of the product. If the product is found unused, the replacement product will be shipped out to you and will reach you in our standard delivery time i.e. 7-14 business days for domestic shipments. Can I exchange the exchanged product I received? If a piece is exchanged once, it cannot be exchanged the second time. When will I receive my credit note? If your purchase is eligible for a free return or exchange as explained above, the credit note will also include the proportionate shipping charge. The credit note will be valid for 3 months from the date of issuance. A credit note for any returns or exchanges will only be sent to the registered email address or the email address used to make the purchase. You will not be able to split the credit note amount for two new orders. If the price for the new item selected is more than the credit note amount, you can pay the balance by credit card, online bank transfer, PayPal or Paytm. refund.text: No Refunds / Exchanges At Dhuni, we celebrate the uniqueness of handcrafted items. As such, we do not offer refunds or exchanges for minor irregularities that add character to our products. Simply contact us via WhatsApp within 2 working days of delivery and we will facilitate the exchange process. Final confirmation on exchange will be given only after discussion with the customer and proper due diligence by our internal team once the product is received by us. Here's what you need to do: Contact us via WhatsApp at 9650298102 to report the defect Ensure the original packaging is intact when sending the item back. In the unlikely event that an item is returned to us in an unsuitable condition, we may have to send it back to you. refund.text: Return Policy Note By Khamir Before you return a Khamir product, please take a moment to understand how our products are made. All our products are handcrafted by traditional craft persons in rural Kutch, resulting in each product being unique and slightly different from each other. Let's not think of an irregular weave or print or a stitch as a defect. Handloom by definition means a glorious uncertainty when it comes to uniformity. In spite of these variables, at Khamir we stand behind the quality of our products and we will replace the product free of cost if you are not satisfied with your purchase for any reason. Please read below our return & exchange policies before you return any item. Returnable Product Non-Returnable Products Fabric Masks Clothing Handkerchief Accessories Key-Chains Home-Furnishing Bells – May Be Kitchenware Fabric – Less than 2 mtr Footwear Product in Sale Home-Decor International Orders If your goods are damaged or if you receive an incorrect product, or if you’re simply not satisfied with what you have received, we would be happy to give you the following alternative: a. Exchange the goods for an alternative of your choice of equal value b. Give you a full refund for the price you paid for the goods Products that are eligible for a return, can be returned within 10 days of receiving the merchandise. Customers will have to ship the returnable products themselves via a COD courier service. If not, we will refund the shipping charges. Please ensure that the returned merchandise is unused, unworn, unwashed, undamaged, and is in a salable condition. We request you to maintain the original packaging of the items to be returned, including the KHAMIR tags. Please ensure that all the returned items are packed securely and safely to prevent any loss or damage during transit. In the case of exchanges, your new order will be dispatched to you within 3-5 business days after we receive the earlier shipment. In the unlikely event that your merchandise arrives damaged, you should email us ( orders@khamir.org ) a photo of the damaged product with the Bar Code within 48 hours of receiving your order. Customers can only return non-returnable products if there are defects and deficiencies in the Product (attributable to, and accepted by KHAMIR after due verification at its sole discretion) or if such Non-returnable Products are delivered late (except in case of force majeure including COVID-19). The User shall return such non-returnable products not later than 7 (seven) days from the date of delivery of the product. Not all products are eligible for returns. In order to maintain fairness to our artisans and craftsmen, as well as keep our prices fair, many items are "Final Sale." Please make it a point to understand which products are eligible for returns before purchasing. The KHAMIR team must receive and approve your return request. Once your request is received and approved, you will have to courier it to us by any nearest courier service. Once your return has been authorized, we'd be happy to process your refund. You can choose to receive the refund in the form of store credit, which will reflect in your KHAMIR account within 24 working hours from when the product is picked up by our courier partner. However, if you'd like to receive the amount back to the same payment mode that you used to place this order, we will initiate the refund after we receive the item and it has gone through the necessary quality checks. We aim to process all returns within one (1) week While KHAMIR has made reasonable endeavors to ensure delivery and pick-ups across multiple locations in India, currently, KHAMIR has a select list of areas where deliveries and collection can be undertaken by its reverse logistics partners. In events where KHAMIR is unable to facilitate a pick-up of the purchased Product for return from the User, the User is required to self-ship the Product to KHAMIR’s shipping warehouse, the address for which will be intimated to the customer upon placing such request for return. Upon self-shipping the Product to KHAMIR’s warehouse, the customer shall be required to scan the courier/postal receipt to KHAMIR for KHAMIR’s records. The aforesaid return by self-shipping the Products is subject to the returned products passing quality check at KHAMIR’s returns desk/warehouse. In the event where the customer claims to have self-shipped the Product in accordance with the process set out in paragraph 7 above and KHAMIR does not receive the returned product or the package containing such product is empty, the User shall be required to submit the ‘proof of delivery’ received from the courier/postal agency to KHAMIR to prove his/her claim of return of Products through self-shipment to KHAMIR. It is specifically clarified that any refunds shall be processed by KHAMIR only upon receiving the returned Products and concluding required quality checks or receiving the ‘proof of delivery’ from the User, as the case may be. Shipping charges for self-shipping will not be refunded and customers are required to pay for the shipping costs to return the goods to the applicable return address if the pin code is out of the pickup location. Note: - Some of the pin codes are not feasible for reverse pick-up, in such cases the customer will need to send it back to us. Please note we do not offer reverse pick facilities outside India. Cancellation Policy If the cancellation request is received after your product has been shipped, you can do one of the following: 1. If your product has shipped but has not yet been delivered, contact Customer Support and inform them of the same. We will recall the parcel. 2. If you received the product, inform us, we'll get it picked up under standard return/replacement procedures mentioned above on this page. Cancellation requests will be accepted strictly within 24 hours of placing the order only. A customer is permitted to fully or partially cancel orders prior to its dispatch from KHAMIR. Refund In all events of cancellation prior to the dispatch of the purchased Products, KHAMIR shall initiate refunds within 2 (two) business days from the date on which it received the request from the customer. You can cancel/return a part of your order. Write to us with your order number. If your order contains products sold in SALE , we would not accept any returns/exchange/replacement requests. Sale products are a final sale only.

shipping.text: All of Khamir’s orders are shipped door-to-door from our warehouse in Kukma, Bhuj, Gujarat India to your provided shipping address via local courier agencies. Processing the order normally takes 2 working days and then Shipping normally takes 4-6 working days depending on the location from Khamir warehouse. Shipping destinations offered by www.shop.khamir.org for delivery will be extended and updated from time to time and listed online. We do not ship backorders (items out of stock). We aim to keep every item on our website in stock. If there is an item that you purchase and then we realize this item is not available, we will promptly inform you within 2 working days of your purchase and fully refund your money for the out-of-stock item. We can only process one shipping address per order. So, if you would like to order several items and ship them to different people, please treat these as separate orders. We cannot ship to Post Office Box addresses and take no responsibility for non-delivery of orders in case the delivery address includes P. O. Box details in any part or form. For orders within India, our courier agencies will attempt delivery 3 times at the delivery address specified by you in the order, before they contact us that your package is not deliverable. You can track the package through the Order Tracking facility. If the package status is shown as undeliverable please call the courier service's Customer Service at their local number and quote your tracking number to trace your package. At KHAMIR, we take great care in delivering your products to you, and we partner only with reputed national couriers. Shipping within India is FREE for all orders above Rs. 1200. For orders below that, we charge a flat Rs. 100 shipping fee. Because each craftsperson and artisan's process is unique, shipping times may vary. Look for shipping info on the product page for individual shipping times. Our courier partners will be able to deliver the shipment to you between Monday through Saturday: 9 am to 7 pm. Working days exclude public holidays and Sundays. Delivery time is subject to factors beyond our control including unexpected travel delays from our courier partners and transporters due to weather conditions and strikes. Address change will be accepted only if the order has not been shipped. Address change is only possible if the new location is within the same state. As soon as your package ships, we will email you your package tracking information. International Shipping Currently, the process of placing an order for international deliveries is manual -- which means, if you like any product, you can email or WhatsApp (+91 9099908050) us and we will be happy to process your order. We ship across the globe with DHL and FedEx. Real-time shipping is calculated based on your product selection and country. All local taxes and custom duties are charged extra by the Shipping carrier based on your respective country. Most countries allow import up to a certain amount without any duty. This amount is called De Minimis values. Please check following link to know the De Minimis values of your respective country. Country-wise De Minimis Values Disclaimer : These values are subject to change by the respective tax authorities of your country. refund.text: Exchanges and Returns Bagh India offers a free exchange policy; if you are unhappy with the size, fit, style, colour, we can exchange the garment for you with another garment of the same or higher value, the difference amount to paid. No exchange will be done for discounted products. In case of any issue, please contact the customer care; delivery charges will be charged as per actuals for discounted products We do not have a return policy. All our products are handcrafted by traditional craft persons in rural India, resulting in each product being unique and slightly different from each other. An irregular weave or print or a stitch should not be taken as a defect as handcrafted products will not show consistent uniformity like a machine-made product. Handloom, by definition, means a glorious uncertainty when it comes to uniformity. We undergo a thorough quality check before processing your order. In case the delivered item(s) is found damaged/ missing or has any manufacturing defect, please inform us by calling on +91 7490034251 or emailing us at info@baghindia.com within 24 hours of delivery. Exchange of item(s) is subject to the fulfilment of following conditions: The item(s) has not been worn, washed, altered or damaged and is returned in a saleable condition with barcode and MRP Tags intact. Bagh India reserves the right to decide whether the item(s) seems worn, washed, altered or has post-purchase damage. Exchanges can be done within 15 days from the date of delivery for all online orders. Tags should be intact and product should be unused. No exchanges or refunds will be made against garments which have been altered by the customer . No exchanges for garments purchased on sale with discount of 40% or more! Reverse Pick Ups We offer our customers a simple, hassle-free, Reverse Pick-up policy. Our policy is thoughtfully designed to ease up the process, save time and make you feel reassured about your order. Please mention your order number in the subject line to help us quickly process your exchanges. Please ensure that all the returned item(s) are packed securely and safely to prevent any loss or damage during transit. The item(s) for reverse pick up will be picked up within 7 business days from the date of request. After the receipt of item(s), your request for exchanges would be processed. In the case of exchanges, your new order will be dispatched to you within 3-5 business days after we receive the earlier shipment. Delivery of reverse pickups takes anywhere between 7-15 days. Some of the pin codes are not feasible for reverse pick up, in such cases the customer will need to return the item(s) back to us. The reverse shipping address will remain the same as per the original invoice. If customer has self-shipped the item(s) and the package is lost in transit, no refund will be applicable. Shipping Cost on Reverse Pick ups Costs of shipping are borne by the Company only for the first exchange request. Subsequent exchange requests do not carry any such adjustment. In case there are multiple exchanges, customer has to bear the subsequent costs of reverse pick and delivery i.e INR 200 ) "Multiple exchanges" refers to multiple requests for exchange of product(s) (even if the products were purchased in one single order). Cancellations Orders can be cancelled only before shipment has been dispatched. After dispatch, the courier company will attempt the delivery of the order thrice, post which the merchandise is sent back to our warehouse. Kindly note that we do not offer refunds under any circumstances.

refund.text: EXCHANGE & RETURN POLICY We accept exchanges and returns on non-sale items within 10 days of you receiving the shipment A reverse pickup facility from your shipping address is available free of cost Items must be marked as eligible for exchange and return on the product page EXCHANGE & RETURN PROCESS To raise a request, email care@pinklay.com or phone/WhatsApp us at +91-8104136291 We will initiate a reverse pickup from your shipping address within 48 hours Re-use the original packaging, including the cloth bag, for proper care and protection Items must be in their original condition, with their labels and tags intact They must be unused and unwashed, unsoiled without any stains or damages Items returned, once verified at our facility, will be processed for an exchange or return Typically, it takes 10-15 days to complete your exchange or return request REFUND POLICY We issue a store credit for the full amount against all returns There is no reverse shipping fees levied on any return requests First time exchange for size or a different style/product is free A non-refundable shipping fee of Rs 199 will be charged for any subsequent exchange requests or on orders placed using a credit note Store credit is valid for a 1-year period from the date of issue Shipping fees and gift services (if any) are non-refundable Gift cards cannot be returned for their monetary value SALE OR DISCOUNT POLICY Size exchanges available on items under 20% off (subject to size availability) A restocking fee of Rs 199 will be applicable on all exchanges No returns/exchanges on items over 20% off. Request must be placed within 10 days of order being delivered. Items must be in their original condition with their labels/tags intact. Applies to discounted or on sale products, or bought through an offer or promotional code. MISSING OR DAMAGE POLICY A missing or damaged item claim must be raised within 2 days of receiving the parcel. We will need photographs of the item(s) and the delivery parcel it was received in. Our customer care team will investigate and offer an appropriate resolution. CANCELLATION POLICY We accept cancellations against full refund or store credit as long as the order has not been shipped. We are unable to accept any cancellation requests once the order has been shipped. Have a question? Chat with us, or e-mail us at care@pinklay.com , or call/WhatsApp us at +91- 8104136291 . We’d be happy to answer any questions.

shipping.text: SHIPPING POLICY We ship across India.
